info.description:
# Budget - Financial Tracking for Nextcloud
Track your spending habits, manage savings, and forecast future account balances with intelligent analysis of your financial history.
## Features
* **Import Bank Statements**: Support for CSV, Excel and LibreOffice spreadsheets (.xls, .xlsx, .ods), OFX, QIF and ISO 20022 camt.053 XML formats, plus exports from Firefly III, YNAB, Actual Budget, Mint and Monarch Money * **Import Folder**: Drop a statement into a folder in your Files and it is imported in the background, or held for you to review first * **Bank Sync (beta)**: Pull transactions in automatically through GoCardless (UK/EU) or SimpleFIN (US) * **Smart Categorization**: Automatic vendor matching and transaction categorization * **Auto-Categorization Rules**: Apply rules to existing transactions anytime with preview * **Split Transactions**: Allocate single transactions across multiple categories * **Transfer Detection**: Automatic matching of transfers between accounts * **Statement Reconciliation**: Tick transactions off against a bank statement until the difference reaches zero * **Receipt Scanning**: Attach receipt photos to transactions and, once an admin sets it up, read the amount and items from them (OCR) * **Android App, Quick Add and a Public API**: Budget Companion for Android (on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.otherworld.budget) to photograph receipts and check your balances, a fast entry page for your phone, and a REST API for scripts and automation * **Budget Tracking**: Set spending limits with alerts when approaching or exceeding budgets * **Rollover Budgets**: Envelope budgeting, where unspent money (or overspending) carries into the next month * **Project Budgets**: One budget for a job that runs over months, such as a renovation or a wedding * **Balance Forecasting**: Predict future balances based on historical data * **Recurring Bills**: Track bills with due date monitoring and Nextcloud notifications * **Subscription Detection**: Spots payments that look recurring but are not tracked yet, and turns them into bills in one click * **Recurring Income**: Track expected income sources with receipt tracking * **Split Expenses**: Share expenses with one or several people and track who owes whom * **Debt Payoff Planner**: Plan repayment using avalanche or snowball strategies * **Savings Goals**: Set targets with progress tracking and achievement forecasting * **Pension Tracker**: Track retirement accounts with growth projections * **Net Worth History**: Track assets and liabilities over time * **Year-over-Year Reports**: Compare spending across multiple years * **Money Flow Report**: A Sankey diagram of where a period's money came from and went * **Digest and Unusual Spending Alerts**: An optional weekly or monthly summary, and a notification when a category runs well above its usual level * **Scheduled PDF Reports**: Last month's report saved to your Files or emailed to you automatically * **Multi-Account Support**: Manage multiple bank accounts and currencies * **Custom Categories**: Create your own category hierarchy * **Reports & Charts**: Visualize your financial data with interactive charts * **Getting Started Checklist**: A first-run checklist, with sample data to explore before adding your own
## Documentation
Full user documentation: https://budget.otherworld.dev/docs/
## Requirements
* Nextcloud 30 or higher * PHP 8.1 or higher * PHP BCMath extension (`php-bcmath`)
